title: Malmsten
description: malmsten.com Malmsten AB is a Swedish family-owned company founded in 1975 in Täby, the world's leading manufacturer of swimming pool and open water equipment including lane lines, buoys, starting blocks and safety gear. With around 30 employees and global distribution, its equipment has been used at 11 consecutive Olympic Games from Moscow 1980 to Paris 2024. Founder Robert Malmsten received the FINA Gold Pin Award in 2024 for 48 years of service to the international swimming federation's equipment committee. The company's proprietary wave calming technology reduces turbulence in competition lanes, making its Golden Series the gold standard for elite swimming events. Led by CEO David Malmsten in the second generation, it operates a subsidiary in Australia and serves 100 plus national swimming federations worldwide. Key strengths are FINA approval, Olympic heritage and a full product range from elite competition to public pool equipment.
